Name: SSaturn's Tropical Farm
Author: SSaturn0601
Description:
[code]﻿[/code]I'm quarantined and going stir crazy, so I made some stuff.

Used and tested with all latest PPJA mods and Bonster's Crops. Please notify me if you find any future incompatibilities.

All objects come with their own gifting tastes . . . have fun figuring out who likes what!




[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EiRDEek.png[/img][/center]
This mod adds:

- [color=#d5a6bd][b]20 new seeds and saplings[/b][/color] to your game, purchasable from Sandy as of Year 2:

[quote](v 2.0) Arum Lily (aka. calla lily)
(v 1.0) Tuberose
(v 2.0) Amaryllis
(v 1.0) Night-Blooming Jasmine
(v 2.0) Ixora (aka. needle flower, ashoka)
(v 1.0) Chinese Hibiscus
(v 2.0) Bougainvillea
(v 2.0) Lemongrass
(v 1.0) Snakefruit
(v 2.0) Yucca
(v 2.0) Turmeric
(v 2.0) Longan (aka. dragon eye fruit)
(v 2.0) Lemongrass
(v 2.0) Chinese Mesona (aka. cincau, grass jelly leaves)
(v 2.0) Kaffir Lime
(v 2.0) Crown Daisy

(v 1.0) Frangipani Tree
(v 1.0) Rambutan Tree
(v 2.0) Sweetsop Tree (aka. sugar-apple, srikaya)
(v 2.0) Jambu Tree (aka. bell fruit, water apple, rose-apple)[/quote]


-[b] [color=#d5a6bd]6 new cooking recipes[/color][/b] (4 drinks and 2 dishes) using Tropical Farm and SDV base game crops. The drink recipes are purchasable at Sandy's shop while the food recipes will be sent through mail once certain requirements have been met. Discover them on your own, or see the spoiler for a detailed guide. Hint: This mod incentivises you to befriend Sandy.

[code][spoiler]
[/code][b]Drink recipes purchased at Sandy's shop:[/b]
- grass jelly milk tea
- lemongrass tea
- djamu
- tropical fruit punch
[b]
Food recipes sent through mail and their requirements:[/b]
- poached snakefruit (Sandy min. 4 hearts, summer/fall)
- yucca fries (Sandy min. 4 hearts, spring/summer)
[code][/spoiler][/code]

- [color=#d5a6bd][b]8 new cooking ingredients[/b][/color], all purchasable at Sandy's shop. Some can be crafted (recipes known by default) and some can be produced using SDV base game machines. Discover them on your own, or see the spoiler for a detailed guide.

[spoiler]
[b]Craftable ingredients:[/b]
- coconut cream (coconut)
- condensed milk (sugar + milk)

[b]Producible ingredients:[/b]
- oyster sauce (keg - oyster)
- fish sauce (keg - any fish)

[b]Purchasable only ingredients:[/b]
- sweet soy sauce
- corn starch
- palm sugar
- shrimp paste (aka. terasi, belacan, kapi)
[/spoiler]

- [color=#d5a6bd][b]14 new decorative craftables[/b][/color]. Crafting recipes are either sent through the mail or purchasable in the shops once you've met certain conditions. Discover them yourself, or read the spoiler tag for a detailed guide.

[spoiler]
- Potted Amaryllis recipe (Sandy min. 3 hearts, Farming skill min. 3, sent in the fall)
- Potted Arum Lily recipe (Sandy min. 3 hearts, Farming skill min. 3, sent in the spring)
- Potted Tuberose recipe (Sandy min. 3 hearts, Farming skill min. 3, sent in the spring)
- Potted Crown Daisy Recipe (Sandy min. 3 hearts, Farming skill min. 3, sent in the summer)

- Amethyst Vase recipe (Clint min. 3 hearts, Farming skill min. 3)

- 9 various flower vase recipes
Purchasable at Clint's shop once you have received the AMETHYST VASE recipe in the mail, and you have a minimum of three hearts with Clint and a minimum of one heart with Sandy.
Each flower vase recipe is only purchasable in their respective seasons, but can be crafted outside the season once you've purchased it. (eg. the Vase of Amaryllis recipe is only purchasable in autumn, Vase of Frangipani recipe only purchasable in summer, etc.)
[/spoiler]

- [color=#d5a6bd][b]Better Artisan Goods icons[/b][/color] for wine, jelly, honey, juice, and pickle produced from Tropical Farm crops. [b]Requires BAGI to work.
[/b]If you prefer the base game/vanilla artisan good icons, or you don't want to install BAGI as well, you can simply remove the add-on by deleting the [b][BAGI] SSaturn's Tropical Farm[/b] sub-folder.
[b]

[/b]- [color=#d5a6bd][b]PFM integration[/b][/color] for use with other mods. [b]Requires PRODUCER FRAMEWORK MOD to work.[/b]

Seed Maker integration was added with special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/84004333]vNIANHUAv[/url].

Night-blooming jasmine, frangipani, tuberose, amaryllis, and arum lily will now produce DRIED POISON with the DRYER if you have PPJA's Farmer to Florist installed (not required for the mod to work).

KEG will now produce FISH SAUCE with *any fish*, and OYSTER SAUCE with *oysters*.



[center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Rjit5ED.png[/img]﻿[/center]
I'm planning on (eventually) adding:

- star anise
- kewda/screwpine/ocean pandan
- cumin

I'm also open to suggestions/requests as long as they fit the tropical theme, though my pixel art isn't the best so I can't promise anything >_<




[b][size=4][u][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/VDa7V15.png[/img]﻿[/center][/u][/size][/b]
Delete ALL previous SSaturn's Tropical Farm folders, including the optional [b](PFM) SSaturn's Tropical Farm for Seed Maker[/b] if you have had it installed. The PFM is now integrated into the main file and will not require a separate download.

Download and extract SSaturn's Tropical Farm v2, and drop the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.




[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bxUEvfa.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[b][size=4][u][center][/center][/u][/size][/b][b]DO NOT PLACE THE FOLLOWING OBJECTS ON THE GROUND/FLOOR!:
[/b]The AMETHYST VASE and 9 decorative flower vases (Vase of Amaryllis, Vase of Arum Lily, etc.)
In some instances, you won't be able to pick them back up again (with empty hands, pick-axe, hoe, axe, [b]anything!![/b]) I'm not sure what causes this issue, but I also notice this with other 16x16 crafted decorative objects added by other mods.





[center][b][size=4][u][img]https://i.imgur.com/BuYjzMv.png[/img]﻿[/u][/size][/b][/center]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/84004333]vNIANHUAv[/url] for Chinese translations
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48693548]jina2ya[/url] for Korean translations
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/67506381]Ghost3lboom[/url] for Russian translations

thank you also to everyone who has made suggestions on new crops to add!

and finally, special thanks to Spacechase0 for JsonAssets, without which this mod wouldn't work.
